landing.hero.title: A calm, simple way to run your subscription store
landing.hero.description: Sell access, accept payments, and give customers a clear subscription experience through Telegram and the web.
landing.steps: Open your subscription in a client

landing.faq.question: Do I need a card for the trial?
landing.faq.answer: No. The trial is available when the store owner enables it.

landing.faq.question: Where do I get support?
landing.faq.answer: Use the support contact shown by the store owner or open the Telegram bot.
